services.name: Summertime Fishing
services.desc: Experience the thrill of bass fishing on Lake Chatuge, a 7,500-acre gem with 132 miles of shoreline, nestled in the mountains of Hiawassee, Georgia. This picturesque lake, spanning the Georgia-North Carolina border, is teeming with Spotted Bass and boasts a healthy population of Largemouth Bass. Excitingly, the lake is part of North Carolina’s restocking program, promising an increase in Hybrid Bass in the coming years. For a successful fishing trip on Lake Chatuge, focus on laydowns, brush, and long points.
